newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Blydenstein sells U.S. unit.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Blydenstein sells U.S. unit.

text.p: Textiles group Blydenstein-Willink NV said on Friday it had reached agreement to sell Verosol USA to the unit's management.
Verosol USA manufactures blinds and has 75 employees. The unit has been suffering losses for a number of years, a Blydenstein spokesman said, without elaborating.

Blydenstein said the U.S. firm will continue to cooperate with Blydenstein's other Verosol subsidiaries. It will have a licensing agreement to market Verosol cloth in North America. Blydenstein previously said it would move production of Verosol cloth from the U.S. to a new plant in the Netherlands.
